notes: Session 2. Closed B5-0652, a RECORD-ONLY incident log on human order. The B5-0631 concurrent-edit incident was documented in two places that did not connect, solar-pro4-free's completion report and Buffy (glm-5.3-flash)'s own WITHDRAWN-incident report, and the CAUSE was recorded in neither, so this task establishes it from the repository rather than reconstructing it. THE CAUSAL CHAIN, verified not remembered: at 04:39:49Z solar-pro4:free created its B5-0631 claim with a PLACEHOLDER started_utc of 2026-09-27T00:00:00Z, so the claim's own age read 287 minutes against a 30-minute TTL; at 04:46Z Buffy read the census and was told B5-0631 was claimable, and that reading was CORRECT AS IMPLEMENTED because the committed run-queue.ps1 at that moment derived liveness from started_utc ALONE, verified directly against the pre-fix blob at 83ce144f~1 which contains the started_utc-only return and no Get-NormName. THE TOOL DID NOT LIE, THE IMPLEMENTATION WAS WRONG: a placeholder never intended as data was read as data, and a single-signal check converted it into a permission slip for a second writer. Between roughly 04:50Z and 04:53Z their edits to HeadlessConformanceTest.java overlapped and CONSUMED the pre-existing testD6ActionLoop method header, orphaning its body and producing 100 compile errors; Buffy discovered it at 04:51Z from a compile failure in testOrderAndInitiativeSequencing, text she never wrote, which is the most valuable sentence in either report, then verified the competing claim, withdrew surgically, and at 04:56Z restored the header verbatim after a 45-second mtime watch, leaving the claimant's 9 in-progress errors untouched. THE TIMING IS THE LESSON: the two-signal fix was applied to the working tree at ~04:52Z to 04:54Z, MID-INCIDENT, and committed as 83ce144f at 04:58:00Z, verified by reading that commit's local timestamp of 17:58:00 against a measured local-to-UTC offset of exactly 13 hours, the closing second of Buffy's own 04:46Z to 04:58Z window. Correct, would have prevented this, and eight minutes of overlap too late. VERIFIED INDEPENDENTLY with every number produced by running the tool: 9 check() calls all passing across 5 substeps; testD6ActionLoop byte-faithful to the committed original at 56 lines both sides with identical code lines excluding comments and blanks, so the restoration is confirmed not assumed; D6 runs with 3 passing checks; row DONE with a 785-char verified cell attributed to solar-pro4:free; claim released; heartbeat live_claims a real array; validator 27 of 27 exit 0; nothing committed, HEAD == origin, correct because commits are a human decision. ONE FALSE CLAIM recorded rather than glossed: the completion report says both divergences are already in DECISIONS B5-0359 line 1416 plus B5-0409 finding A; line 1416 was read and does record synchronous resolution, but NOT victory-check timing, and B5-0409 mentions neither; the victory-check divergence is at DECISIONS.md:4415 under solar-pro4-free's OWN heading, so it was newly recorded while described as already on file, which is the B5-0606 self-certifying-citation pattern committed by the agent I had launched ten minutes earlier. ATTRIBUTION without exoneration: Buffy violated 00_BOOT step 6 by editing before claiming and its own report says so, but its handling afterwards is the best conduct in the record, and its formulation of the stop rule, that unknown text in your compile output must stop all work INCLUDING fixing the file, is the sharpest here. NOT RESOLVED HERE: the placeholder-timestamp habit at source is a separate proposal, and no ruling is made on whether Buffy should have re-read the census, because the census was correct when she read it. TWO DEVELOPMENTS NOTED: the suite re-run at 05:31Z reports 530 checks all passing rather than 521, because concurrent agents are landing sections continuously, so a point-in-time note was added to the incident record so the figure is not misread as a permanent property; and .agent/tools/census-crosscheck.ps1 has appeared UNTRACKED in the working tree, which is Task 1 of the tool-rule-convergence proposal, so that work is already underway by someone. Gates green: compile.bat Build successful, suite exit 0, heartbeats 27 of 27. Reusable lesson: a liveness check that reads ONE signal converts a placeholder, a default or a clock-skewed value into a permission slip, and verify the fix LANDS before the window it was meant to close.
